interpretation.label: active_error_removed_AMBIGUOUS
interpretation.why: converged head cannot_determine on 3 eligible seeds -- aliased across under-training, representation ceiling and PE-source; NOT a ceiling verdict
interpretation.combination_rule: Preconditions first: reproduction control (ARM_ONLINE_B1 @ eps 0.0 persistence_dominated) on >= 2/3 seeds, else substrate_not_ready_requeue; >= 2 ELIGIBLE (reproduced AND converged) seeds, else substrate_not_ready_requeue. Then on ARM_CONVERGED @ eps 0.1 among eligible seeds, first quorum (>= 2) wins in the order ready -> h_undertrained_confirmed (PASS); persistence_dominated -> h_undertrained_refuted_declared_null (FAIL); cannot_determine -> active_error_removed_AMBIGUOUS (FAIL, not a ceiling verdict); else inconclusive_no_quorum (FAIL). Only C1 is load-bearing for PASS.
